question: What daily offerings and rites accompany worship of the lord of the site?
premises: A site offering is to be made daily.
A peace fire offering is prescribed.
These are performed together with worship of the site lord.
inference: Daily site offerings and a peace fire offering should be performed with worship of the site lord.
plain_english: One should daily perform the site offering and a peace fire offering together with worship of the lord of the site.
